replacement_or_supplementary_sources.what_it_supports: Tokio Marine Holdings official Group Overview one-pager: 8 P&C Insurance companies and 4 Life Insurance companies in 8 countries across Southeast Asia and India; >10,000 employees. (Fetched via markitdown.) Life-company count: 4, not 5.

Lists exactly 4 life subsidiaries: TM Life Insurance Singapore, TM Life Insurance Thailand, TM Life Insurance Malaysia, TM Life Insurance Indonesia. 8 P&C across Singapore, Thailand, Philippines, Malaysia, India, Myanmar, Indonesia, Vietnam.
FY2024 IR download page confirming public 4Q FY2024 Summary Report. Overseas subsidiaries net premiums written ¥2,598,918M FY2024 (+16.4% YoY).

revised_claim_text: Tokio Marine Asia operations (2025): 8 P&C companies, 4 Life Insurance companies (correction: original draft said 5), operating across 8 countries (Singapore, Thailand, Philippines, Malaysia, India, Myanmar, Indonesia, Vietnam) with 10,000+ employees. Tokio Marine Asia Pte Ltd (Singapore) is the regional intermediate holding company wholly owned by Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance Co. Note: '8 countries' includes India and Myanmar — more precisely 'Southeast Asia + India' per Tokio Marine Holdings' own language. Group has 51,000 employees globally (Japan 31,000 / International 20,000). In October 2024 Tokio Marine reportedly paused a ~$1B sale process for its SEA life insurance units (Japan Times, Insurance Journal) — may affect future life-company count.
footnote_for_artifact: Tokio Marine Holdings Group Overview one-pager (tokiomarinehd.com/en/o1ckc9000000qgeb-att/onepager_en.pdf, June 2025; fetched via markitdown); Tokio Marine Asia regional companies register (tokiomarine.com/asia/en/about-us/tokio-marine-asia/our-regional-companies.html); Tokio Marine Holdings FY2024 IR materials (tokiomarinehd.com/en/ir/download/2024.html). Life-company count corrected 5 → 4 to match audited corporate disclosure.
notes: Original '5 life companies' contradicted by both the Tokio Marine Holdings official one-pager PDF and the Tokio Marine Asia subsidiary register — both consistent at 4. Other figures (8 P&C, 8 countries, 10,000+ employees) confirmed. Upgrade Low → Medium. Operational footprint claim now anchored in audited IR disclosure rather than marketing pages. ID&E relationship is a 2024 engineering-consultancy acquisition, not an SEA insurance JV.
